raw.rationale: Betamethasone acetate is a potent glucocorticoid receptor agonist, and glucocorticoids are known to have lineage-selective antiproliferative effects in lymphoid malignancies, but this PRISM panel is entirely adherent solid tumor lines where NR3C1-driven growth inhibition is uncommon and weak; published PRISM screens show glucocorticoids rarely produce lineage-selective killing at 2.5 µM, with only modest sporadic effects in breast and skin lines.
